info.name: HRMS · Assets
info.description: Hardware, software licences, requests, AI fill, import. Run "Config — hardware lists" and "Config — software lists" first: they store the ids the requests use.

exec: const j=pm.response.json(); const t=(j.types||[]).find(x=>x.name==='Laptop'); if(t) pm.environment.set('typeId',t.id); const o=(j.ownership||[])[0]; if(o) pm.environment.set('ownershipId',o.id); const a=(j.statuses||[]).find(x=>x.name==='Available'); if(a) pm.environment.set('availableStatusId',a.id);

const j=pm.response.json(); const t=(j.types||[]).find(x=>x.name==='Subscription'); if(t) pm.environment.set('licenseTypeId',t.id); const c=(j.categories||[])[0]; if(c) pm.environment.set('categoryId',c.id);
